profile.tagline: A little music, a little mystery, and plenty of places to sit.
profile.welcome: Welcome, traveler. This fictional PhiSpace is a public demonstration of a future self-hosted home, not a connection to a real individual's Infinite Porch.

sections.title: THE FRONT ROOM
sections.body: An imaginary host's cozy blue-hour lounge. Pull up a chair and browse the objects they chose to share.

sections.title: THE RECORD SHELF
sections.body: Picture a collection of original synthwave tracks playing on a vintage hi-fi. Music playback and uploads are not enabled in this prototype.

sections.title: THE WORKSHOP
sections.body: Prototype sketches and public project exhibits would live here. Nothing is automatically imported from the owner's device.

sections.title: THE GUESTBOOK
sections.body: The old internet's favorite tradition. A future guestbook will require moderation and explicit published-message permissions; this demo is read-only.
